description: borne de recharge électrique is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by SISA OUEST NÎMES METROPOLE. Electric vehicle charging station, open to the public from 7.30 am to 8 pm. Coverage: SISA OUEST NÎMES METROPOLE. The portal shows the English title as "electric charging station" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is SISA OUEST NÎMES METROPOLE. Its keywords include recharge-vehicules-electriques, charge-point. The listing shows 1 download or service links in PDF. The listing shows 2024-04-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
